source_text: 1j (15.0 mg, 81 µmol) and HBpin (17.8 µL, 0.12 mmol) were used. Purification was performed by MPLC (hexane/ethyl acetate = 9:1 to 7:3, then hexane/ether = 1:1 to 0:1), and finally by GPC to afford 5.9 mg of 2j as a colorless oil in a 23% yield. NOE was observed between H-1 and H-3 and not observed between H-1 and H-2. This result indicates that 2j has cis configuration between the N group and the B group
